name: Entrance Animation for Gutenberg Blocks
author: Zakaria Binsaifullah

sections.description:
Add Entrance animation to any Gutenberg blocks easily using this block extension. A number of amazing entrance animations are available to use. You can customize its other options like Animation Duration, Delay, Repeat Animation, and Infinite Loop Animation.

Key Features

  • Simple, light-weight, and fast
  • Add CSS3 animations to any Gutenberg blocks
  • 35+ Animations
  • Custom Animation Options
  • No third-party dependency
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gutenyx-blocks-animation directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
